articles.title: Another Vietnam? Trump's Top General Looking To Escape Iran War; 'Airpower Alone Won’t Win War'
articles.description: A bombshell CNN report claims U.S. Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Dan Caine has privately pushed senior officials to find an “off-ramp” from the war. According to sources cited by CNN, Caine has warned that further escalation could backfire and that airpower alone may not be enough to achieve President Donald Trump’s objectives. The concerns reportedly come as Washington faces several major challenges—including the risk of Iranian retaliation, pressure on U.S. weapons stockpiles and growing fears that strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure could trigger an even wider regional conflict.

articles.title: ‘Wherever A Moscal Is Being Beaten...’: Polish President Uses Slur For Russians In Trump-Style Rant
articles.description: Polish president Karol Nawrocki has stoked a major row over his slur at Russia amid the Ukraine conflict. While marking the first anniversary of his inauguration, Nawrocki in his speech emphasised a "Poland First" agenda and reaffirmed support for Ukraine's defense against Russia. During his address, Nawrocki used the term "Moscal" to refer to Russians—a historical Slavic term meaning "Muscovite" that is widely regarded today in parts of Eastern Europe as an ethnic slur. His remarks have drawn attention for their strong rhetoric and nationalist tone. Nawrocki argued that it was in Poland's strategic interest for Ukraine to resist Russian forces while also insisting that Polish national interests must remain the government's top priority.
